python3 -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Verify formulas
print('Total Income formula:', ws['B8'].value)
print('Total Expenses formula:', ws['C23'].value)
print('Balance formula:', ws['B25'].value)

# Verify expense range C11:C22 and income range B4:B7
expense_vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value for r in range(11, 23)]
income_vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value for r in range(4, 8)]
print('Expense cells C11:C22:', expense_vals)
print('Income cells B4:B7:', income_vals)

total_expenses = sum(v for v in expense_vals if isinstance(v, (int, float)))
total_income = sum(v for v in income_vals if isinstance(v, (int, float)))
print(f'Total Expenses = {total_expenses}')
print(f'Total Income = {total_income}')
print(f'Balance = {total_income - total_expenses}')
"
